# KiCad library files

The symbols and footprints in this folder are copied unchanged from the official KiCad 10.0.7
libraries (https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries, shipped in the `kicad/kicad:10.0.7` image).

that an electronic design that uses this material can be considered Adapted Material, the
copyright holders waive article 3 of the license for those designs and for any files generated
from them. See https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/.
